name: sandowl
description: SandOwl — evidence, world models, population trials, and social simulation

scripts.setup: pnpm run setup:backend && pnpm run setup:oasis-worker && pnpm run setup:frontend
scripts.lint:backend: cd backend && uv run ruff check . && uv run ruff format --check .
scripts.test:oasis-worker: cd backend/oasis_worker && uv run --python 3.11 python -m pytest
scripts.lint:oasis-worker: cd backend/oasis_worker && uv run --python 3.11 ruff check . && uv run --python 3.11 ruff format --check .
scripts.migrate: cd backend && uv run alembic upgrade head
scripts.migrate:check: cd backend && uv run alembic heads
scripts.verify: pnpm run migrate:check && pnpm run test:backend && pnpm run lint:backend && pnpm run test:oasis-worker && pnpm run lint:oasis-worker && pnpm run test:frontend && pnpm run typecheck:frontend && pnpm run build:frontend && docker compose --env-file .env.example config --quiet
scripts.stack:media-sync: docker compose --env-file ${SANDOWL_ENV_FILE:?SANDOWL_ENV_FILE is required for media sync} --profile media-sync up --build
scripts.import:agendascope: docker compose --env-file ${SANDOWL_ENV_FILE:?SANDOWL_ENV_FILE is required for AgendaScope import} run --rm media-sync-worker python -m app.media.import_agendascope
scripts.import:matraix-personas: docker compose --env-file ${SANDOWL_ENV_FILE:-.env.example} run --rm -e MATRAIX_PERSONA_DATASET_PATH=/matraix-personas --volume "${MATRAIX_PERSONA_DATASET_PATH:?MATRAIX_PERSONA_DATASET_PATH is required}:/matraix-personas:ro" backend python -m app.populations.import_matraix
